{{Quote|With all due respect, Senator Antilles, Supreme Chancellor Valorum was not made aware of the investment in Valorum Shipping until last week. Regardless, while it's true that the company bears the Valorum name, and that the Supreme Chancellor is a member of the board of directors, he does not participate in company operations, or involve himself with each and every commonplace business transaction.|Finis Valorum's lawyer|<ref name="CoD" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Lawyer/Legends|lawyer]] who acted as the spokesperson for [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum's]] team of lawyers during a corruption [[Supreme Court inquiry against Finis Valorum|inquiry]] brought against him by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]], the chair of the [[Internal Activities Committee]], before the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Supreme Court/Legends|Supreme Court]]<ref name="CoD" /> in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' to [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].</ref>
